hypothesis: A small set of close-confirmed entry-quality vetoes may avoid losing MR40 entry episodes without sacrificing more profitable trades. No modification to RR/stop/sizing; preserve all existing natural exits.

candidate_filters.rule: TR[j]<=1.75*mean(TR[j-14:j]), using immediately preceding 14 completed bars for reference

decision_timing: Only first positive MR40 target bar in each contiguous episode j; observed after 4h candle j closes. If vetoed, all target bars in that episode disabled until episode ends; original Z>=0 natural exits preserved for accepted episodes. No skipping to a later signal within rejected episode. All decisions at next open i=j+lag, no future data. Keep original cash sizing, fee/slippage, no stop. One independent portfolio path per candidate. Do not permit partial re-entry.

validation.reference_cash_attribution: For each baseline entry record win/loss and realized pnl, compare veto decisions at identical first signal. Quantify excluded losing trades AND winning trades, lost winning net profit; do not claim counterfactual per-trade Pnl sums equal compounded filtered portfolio results.
validation.gates: Freeze train selection: normal PNL>=baseline; stress PNL>=1.05*baseline; normal DD<=0.9*baseline; >=60% of baseline winners retained and >=70% of summed baseline winning PnL preserved, trade count retained >=40%. Qualified selected by highest stress PNL, else baseline. For evaluation selected must normal PNL>=baseline, stress PNL>=baseline, normal DD<=0.9*baseline, retain >=60% winners and >=70% summed winner PNL, else no promotion. Even success cannot substitute genuinely unseen forward observations.
validation.input_proof: Previous pinned Bybit prepared input/extension and LBank native archive, with hashes from MR40 entry-stop engine; assert exact baseline fill/equity parity (existing engine), independently replay each candidate account ledger, temporal prefix consistency.

restriction: Research-only. Paper 500 USDT on Laptop2 untouched; Live=false; no exchange private APIs or real orders; no automatic deployment or merge.
